# Rebalancing results (generated by `python -m bixi.rebalancing`)

45 days (the Step 7 forecast run). Plans use day-ahead forecasts; every day is
scored with the flows that actually happened. A problem hour is a station-hour in which
some departures found no bike (empty) or some arrivals found no free dock (full).

Assumptions: trucks carry 20 bikes, drive at 18 km/h
(x1.3 detour), 4 min per stop, 0.5 min per bike; rebalancing windows 5-7 h, 13-15 h; dock counts from the live feed, no staffed overflow docking.

## Default scenario: stations 50% full at midnight, 2 trucks

| Strategy | Problem hours / day | Empty | Full | Reduction | Share of perfect foresight | Bikes moved / day | Truck km / day |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| none | 161 | 85 | 76 | 0.0% | 0% | 0 | 0 |
| rule_forecast | 140 | 74 | 66 | 13.2% | 44% | 81 | 65 |
| optimized_forecast | 130 | 70 | 59 | 19.6% | 66% | 141 | 55 |
| optimized_oracle | 113 | 62 | 51 | 29.8% | 100% | 148 | 54 |
